# Screen 196 · Consent register and statistics

Shared src/screens/ConsentRegister.tsx and generated client are mounted with the distinct Owner / Hospital Admin as demo.owner workspace access and F1 page. Native consent print uses the same verified record/payload identity and direction checks as clinical consent, with a new exact workspace boundary. English/Urdu help, role guidance and real terminal screenshots ship with this screen.

Owner / Hospital Admin as demo.owner read fresh synthetic unsigned drafts CN-2026-000001 and CN-2026-000002. Actual backend filters category Procedure, Draft, and unscanned=true (no matching signed forms) were exercised. The UI showed the actual frozen form text and draft decision state, English LTR preview and server PDF 200, Urdu RTL print-payload preview and a native PDF with %PDF- signature. Statistics returned real MSDS 72, 43, 35 and 74 ii measures for the hospital month and separate empty counts. F1 restored focus on the open button and statistics date. English/Urdu 250% in both themes passed. 196-journey.json contains request IDs and no business writes. Mandatory handbook coverage (195 screens), TypeScript and DEV build passed after adding a dedicated statistics refresh control. The first Quality harness locator was fixed and both workspaces passed on rerun.

Limits: no signed outcomes or nonempty breakdown fixture, no physical printer, no separate live-event observer, and no named human, translation or editorial sign-off.
